chunks: Whoever is buried in the Sacred Sanctuary will be safe from the Great Terror, whether among the righteous people or their sinful ones.

key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the Sacred Sanctuary, especially the inviolable holy precinct
key_terms.الْفَزَعِ الْأَكْبَرِ: the greatest terror or supreme dread of the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of being buried in the Sacred Sanctuary according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that whoever is buried in the Sacred Sanctuary is granted safety from the Great Terror of the Hereafter. It presents burial in the Haram as a cause of divine security, applying to people whether righteous or sinful.
